# onetsolutions_hosting_database_users (Data Source)

Lists the MySQL users of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_database_users" "all" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "database_users" {
  value = [for item in data.onetsolutions_hosting_database_users.all.database_users : item.username]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `database_users` (Attributes List) The database users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--database_users))

<a id="nestedatt--database_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `database_users`

Read-Only:

- `username` (String) The full username, prefixed with the web hosting's username.
